products.amerkar.name: aMerkar
products.amerkar.tagline: Organize your shopping. Manage your home.
products.amerkar.shortDescription: Shopping lists, inventory and home organization, shared with your family.
products.amerkar.description: aMerkar is an application to organize shopping lists, products, past purchases and everyday household shopping management, built to be used as a family.
products.amerkar.problem: Coordinating household shopping between several people usually ends up in duplicate products, forgotten items and paper lists that get lost. aMerkar brings all of that into one place, shared in real time.
products.amerkar.features.sharing: Share lists by code or link
products.amerkar.features.purchaseHistor: Purchase history with price and place
products.amerkar.benefits.familyCoordina: Coordinate shopping with the whole family
products.amerkar.faq.isFree.question: Does aMerkar cost anything?
products.amerkar.faq.isFree.answer: aMerkar is available for anyone to organize their household shopping in a simple way.
products.amerkar.faq.ownAccount.question: Do I need a RaframGo account to use it?
products.amerkar.faq.ownAccount.answer: No. aMerkar has its own sign-in, independent from RaframGo. You just need to create an account inside the application.
products.amerkar.faq.platforms.question: What devices does aMerkar work on?
products.amerkar.faq.platforms.answer: aMerkar works in the browser, on both computer and phone, and can be installed as an app (PWA) on Android and iPhone.
products.amerkar.faq.dataSecurity.answer: Yes. Every household and every list is private by design: only the people you decide to invite can see them.

about.heading: About RaframGo
about.intro: RaframGo is the brand behind digital applications designed to solve everyday problems in a simple way.
about.whatIsText: RaframGo is a digital products brand. It's not a single application: it's the starting point from which different applications are presented and connected, each with its own identity and purpose.
about.philosophyText: We believe in building simple, useful and approachable products, rather than adding features for the sake of it. Every RaframGo application focuses on solving one specific problem well.
about.visionText: aMerkar is the first product in the RaframGo ecosystem. The idea is to keep adding applications over time, keeping the same philosophy: simple products that solve real problems, without depending on a single application to exist.
about.stageNote: RaframGo is at an early stage: we'd rather grow with solid steps than promise more than what we've already built.

privacy.heading: Privacy
privacy.intro: This portal (RaframGo) is a presentation site: it doesn't require you to create an account or sign in to browse it.
privacy.dataText: The portal itself doesn't ask you for personal data to browse it. The only cookies we use are the ones described below. If you enter a product like aMerkar, that product has its own privacy policy and its own data handling, independent from this portal.
privacy.cookiesText: We use essential cookies for the site to work (for example, remembering your language and your cookie choice) and, if you accept them, optional analytics cookies to understand how the portal is used.
privacy.rightsText: You can write to us at raframgo@outlook.com for any request related to your data.
privacy.productsNote: Each product in the RaframGo ecosystem (like aMerkar) has its own privacy policy, specific to the data that application handles.
terms.heading: Terms of use
terms.intro: By using this portal, you agree to these terms of use.
terms.useText: This portal is public and informational: it presents the RaframGo brand and its products. It doesn't require registration or authentication.
terms.productsText: Each product linked from this portal (like aMerkar) has its own terms of use, which apply once you start using it.
terms.changesText: We may update these terms. Significant changes will be reflected in the last updated date.
terms.contactText: If you have questions about these terms, write to us at raframgo@outlook.com.
